story_zh: 晚上，客人们来到餐馆。服务员拿来菜单，大家点了新鲜的面包、甜蛋糕和香蕉。饮料有啤酒，装在瓶子里。我们用筷子和碗、盘子吃饭。开始很饿，吃完后感觉很饱。
story_pinyin: Wǎnshàng, kèrénmen lái dào cānguǎn. Fúwùyuán ná lái càidān, dàjiā diǎn le xīnxiān de miànbāo, tián dàngāo hé xiāngjiāo. Yǐnliào yǒu píjiǔ, zhuāng zài píngzi lǐ. Wǒmen yòng kuàizi hé wǎn, pánzi chīfàn. Kāishǐ hěn è, chī wán hòu gǎnjué hěn bǎo.
story_en: In the evening, guests come to the restaurant. The waiter brings the menu, and everyone orders fresh bread, sweet cake, and bananas. For drinks, there is beer in bottles. We eat with chopsticks, bowls, and plates. We were very hungry at first, but after eating, we feel very full.
